title: root_dio_signature.py: from_cose_sign1 assumes unprotected header is dict
description:
In from_cose_sign1() line 228, unprotected.get(COSE_KID_LABEL) assumes the unprotected header is a dict. If a malformed COSE_Sign1 structure has a non-dict value (e.g., None, array), this raises AttributeError instead of a clear ValueError.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py
Line: 228

Failure scenario: Attacker sends COSE_Sign1 with unprotected header as null or array. Verifier crashes with AttributeError instead of rejecting with proper validation error. May leak implementation details or cause unexpected crash paths.

Fix: Validate isinstance(unprotected, dict) before calling .get().
